{{short description|Swiss mathematician}}
'''Christine Riedtmann''' (born 1952){{r|wc}} is a Swiss mathematician specializing in [[abstract algebra]]. She earned her PhD in 1978 from the [[University of Zurich]] under the supervision of [[Pierre Gabriel]],{{r|mgp}} and is a [[professor emeritus]] (since 2016) at the [[University of Bern]].{{r|unibe}}

In 2012–2013 she was president of the [[Swiss Mathematical Society]].{{r|sms}}
